questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word opposite in meaning to the word given.**

Dissension
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Harmony**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"dissension"** means disagreement that leads to discord within a group or among individuals. (विवाद)

 
 
• **Example: **The board meeting was filled with dissension over the new policy changes.
 
 
 
• **"Harmony"** refers to a state of peaceful agreement and cooperation, where all parties are in accord. (सामंजस्य)
 
 
• **Example: **The community lived in harmony, with everyone respecting each other's differences.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'dissension'** is **'harmony'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Harmony**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bickering** (झगड़ा): Petty and trivial arguing.

 
 
• **Example:** The siblings were constantly bickering over the smallest things.
 
 
 
• **Controversy** (विवाद): Prolonged public disagreement or heated discussion.
 
 
• **Example:** The new law sparked a lot of controversy among the citizens.
 
 
 
• **Strife** (संघर्ष): Angry or bitter disagreement over fundamental issues.
 
 
• **Example:** The country has been torn apart by strife for decades.

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'. **

He puts the birds softly, (1)/ one by one, interior their (2)/little warm home./ (3) No Error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'2' i.e. error lies in part 2 of the sentence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**In part 2 of the sentence,** the usage of **'interior' **is incorrect Instead, use **'in'**

 
• **'Interior' **here is an adjective that is not qualifying any noun. Hence, we need an adverb here to tell the place where he puts the birds.
 
• Also, read this sentence like this he puts the birds softly now asks the question **where?**
 
• So the answer should be an adverb. 

**So the correct sentence is-** *He puts the birds softly, one by one, in their little warm home.*

questions.question:
**In the following question, a sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect speech. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Indirect/Direct speech.**

The coach said to the child, "Don't make the water muddy".

options.text: The coach commanded the child don't make the water muddy.

The coach commanded to the child don't make the water muddy.

questions.solution: Direct speech describes when something is being repeated exactly as it was, usually in between a pair of inverted commas. Indirect speech is a report on what someone else said or wrote without using that person's exact words. Here, the correct answer is,* The coach commanded the child not to make the water dirty. *We can see how in the mentioned solution, the commands of the coach are being reported

questions.question:
**In the following question, a sentence has been given in Active/Passive voice. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active voice. **

My daughter read the entire novel in one day.

options.text: The entire novel is read by my daughter in one day
In one day my daughter read the entire novel.
The entire novel was read by my daughter in one day.
In one day my daughter has read the entire novel.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'The entire novel was read by my daughter in one day.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The main verb of the sentence is 'read' the given sentence is in the past tense. We get to know this by the subject if the sentence has the verb 'reads' then we can say that the sentence is in the present tense but the sentence doesn't have this so we can say that the sentence is in the past tense.
 
• In passive voice, the subject of the sentence will become an object and the object of the sentence will become the subject.
 
• The passive voice will be- was + v₃ + by + object.

**So the correct passive voice is-** *The entire novel was read by my daughter in one day.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Inhibitor"** means something that restrains, hinders, or prevents an action or process. (अवरोधक)
 
 
• **Example: **The presence of a strong inhibitor can significantly slow down the chemical reaction.
 
 
 
• **"Avoidance"** refers to the act of keeping away from or preventing something from happening. (परिहार)
 
 
• **Example: **His avoidance of the issue only made the situation worse.

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Advocate** (समर्थक): A person who publicly supports or recommends a particular cause or policy.
 
 
• **Example:** She is a strong advocate for women's rights.
 
 
 
• **Subsidy** (सब्सिडी): A sum of money granted by the government or a public body to assist an industry or business so that the price of a commodity or service may remain low or competitive.
 
 
• **Example:** The government provides subsidies to farmers to help them manage their costs.
 
 
 
• **Compensation** (मुआवजा): Something, typically money, awarded to someone in recognition of loss, suffering, or injury.
 
 
• **Example:** He received compensation for the injuries he sustained in the accident.
